summary.text: Matthew Mobilia is a Staten Island trial attorney and former Richmond County prosecutor running as the Democratic nominee against incumbent Samuel Pirozzolo for the second consecutive election. He worked as a prosecutor and then a court attorney in Kings County Civil Court before opening his own law practice in 2022. His campaign website describes a platform built on public safety, the local economy, neighborhoods and human rights.

paragraphs.text: Mobilia was born and raised in Staten Island. He earned a B.A. in politics from Saint Anselm College and a J.D. from Albany Law School in 2015.

After law school he worked for four years as a prosecutor in the Richmond County District Attorney's Office under DA Michael E. McMahon, handling cases including homicides, burglaries, DWI and narcotics offenses and trying cases to verdict.
He then served as an Associate Court Attorney to Judge Matthew P. Blum of Kings County Civil Court, handling no-fault, commercial landlord-tenant, civil and small-claims matters.
Mobilia opened The Law Office of Matthew Mobilia in 2022, a practice handling criminal defense, personal injury and real estate matters.
He ran for Assembly District 63 in 2024 as a Democrat and lost the general election to incumbent Samuel Pirozzolo.
He is the 2026 Democratic nominee, also on the Affordable & Safe Party line.
Describing himself as a seasoned trial lawyer and local business owner, he lists public safety, the local economy, neighborhoods and human rights as his four focus areas on his campaign website.
